No CSV/JSON content was altered. This single manifest supersedes the three prior manifests (ablation_evidence_manifest.json, ablation_evidence_manifest_overlay.json, _overlay/overlay_evidence_manifest.json); every SHA-256 below was recomputed from the on-disk relocated file and re-verified against the prior committed manifest (0 mismatches).
path_convention: Every 'path' is relative to this manifest's directory (benchmarks/cec_reference_results/_ablation/).

X-ABL-01_scaffold.scope: interaction_graph_enabled=false in EVERY cell (SGSM/ISM interaction-structure memory OFF). This is a remove-one scaffold ablation CONDITIONAL on SGSM off; it CANNOT establish SGSM's own effect (that is campaign X-ABL-02, running separately). Remove-one deltas are conditional contributions given all other components enabled and SGSM off, NOT independent causal effects.

X-ABL-02_sgsm_overlay.scope: Companion to X-ABL-01 (7-cell scaffold, cec2017, SGSM OFF in every cell). X-ABL-01 CANNOT establish SGSM's own effect; X-ABL-02 (this overlay) is that direct isolation, at CEC2013 D50 (interaction_graph_min_dim=50 -> D50 is the SGSM-active tier for CEC2013).

cec2017_panels.scope: Extends the direct SGSM isolation to the PRIMARY suite at its SGSM-active tiers (CEC2017 D50/D100). Same 4-cell overlay design as the CEC2013 D50 panel; promoted 2026-07-13 after the primary freeze, altering no primary result.

X-ABL-02_sgsm_overlay.counts_scope: files/cell_files/analysis_files/bytes describe the CEC2013 D50 panel (summary+provenance+analysis, curves excluded), preserving the field's original semantics; whole-overlay-group totals live in groups.overlay.

overlay_finding.headline: At CEC2013 D50 (SGSM-active tier; 51-run rerun) the DIRECT SGSM isolation (full vs no_sgsm) shows NO significant standalone benefit (Holm p=0.647; W/T/L 13/3/12). Adaptive gate Holm p=0.235; eigenframe final polish Holm p=0.00173 (significant).

correction_trigger_mapping.T-1_IN-02_LM-02_MT-05_C1: TRIGGERED -> narrow (SGSM null / mildly net-negative). Supplement-only per G0; must NOT be back-ported to upgrade any shipped claim.
correction_trigger_mapping.T-5_MT-09_C2_polish: NOT triggered (polish significant at D50); no editorial demotion of C2 forced. Positive polish result is supplement-only per G0; does not upgrade C2 to efficacy.

overlay_finding.honesty: 51-run re-evaluation, verified against abl-rel-2026-07-20 (overlay cells run 2026-07-20): the direct SGSM isolation is a null at every active tier (Holm p = 0.98 / 0.90 / 0.65 for CEC2017 D50 / D100 / CEC2013 D50). At CEC2013 D50 the mean-rank point estimate mildly favors SGSM-ON (full holds the best rank, 2.036 vs 2.232; delta +0.196) while the raw-run effect size leans to SGSM-OFF (mean A12 0.419) - the two point estimates disagree in sign and neither approaches significance, so no directional reading is reported. Only the final polish is Holm-significant (p = 0.0018 / 0.0052 / 0.0017). One-directional per ablation_correction_triggers.md: narrows the SGSM/C1 story, inflates nothing.
